suggestions.title: Path variables
suggestions.body: Store paths like $PROJECTS/upex with roots in config.json. Moving the projects folder or a drive letter means one edit, not 40.

suggestions.title: Per-machine path mapping
suggestions.body: Same links.json on two PCs where E:\ on one is D:\ on the other. Map roots per hostname so export/import just works.

suggestions.title: upex sync
suggestions.body: Keep links.json + config.json in a git repo or cloud folder and pull/push on demand. Builds on export/import.

suggestions.title: Selector preview line
suggestions.body: Show the highlighted shortcut's full path, git branch and last-used time under the list. Less guessing between similar names.

suggestions.title: On-open hooks per shortcut
suggestions.body: Optional command run when a shortcut opens (git pull, docker compose up, nvm use). Turns opening a project into starting it.

suggestions.title: Per-shortcut env vars
suggestions.body: Env vars injected into terminals opened from a shortcut (NODE_ENV, PORT, API keys from a file). Pairs with cmd and claude openers.

suggestions.title: Project type detection
suggestions.body: Spot package.json, .sln, Cargo.toml, pyproject and suggest the matching opener or run scripts. Better defaults with no config.

suggestions.title: Import from other tools
suggestions.body: Seed shortcuts from VS Code recent workspaces, zoxide/autojump history or Windows Terminal profiles.

suggestions.title: WSL and remote openers
suggestions.body: Open a shortcut in a WSL terminal (path translated) or in VS Code Remote-SSH / dev container.

suggestions.title: upex new <name> --template
suggestions.body: Create a folder from a template (copy dir or git clone), register it and open it in one step.

suggestions.title: JSON output flag
suggestions.body: list, go, tag and doctor print machine-readable JSON with --json. Makes upex scriptable from other tools and agents.

suggestions.title: Dry run for openers
suggestions.body: A dry-run flag prints the exact command upex would spawn instead of running it. Debugs custom openers and platform quirks fast.

suggestions.title: ASCII-only glyphs
suggestions.body: Setting that swaps ‹ › ▏ ─ … ↑↓ for plain ASCII in the selector, for terminals or fonts that show boxes.

suggestions.title: Per-shortcut color label
suggestions.body: Optional color (or emoji) per shortcut, shown as a dot before the name in the selector and upex ui, to spot work vs personal at a glance.

suggestions.title: Show archived setting
suggestions.body: Archived shortcuts hidden, dimmed at the bottom, or in their own tab.

suggestions.title: Fuzzy strictness setting
suggestions.body: Exact, normal or loose: sets the Fuse threshold for the filter and name resolution.

suggestions.title: Search scope setting
suggestions.body: Filter matches the name only, or name + path + tags.

suggestions.title: Usage column setting
suggestions.body: Hide usage, show the open count, or show relative time like 3d ago.

suggestions.title: Flash duration setting
suggestions.body: Success flash fades after 3s, 6s, or stays until the next key.

suggestions.title: Tag filter in selector
suggestions.body: Typing #web filters to that tag; a key cycles through tags.

suggestions.title: Number keys open rows
suggestions.body: 1 to 9 opens that visible row right away. Needs care with the filter input.

suggestions.title: Git dirty badge in selector
suggestions.body: A dot on rows whose repo has uncommitted changes. Pairs with ls --dirty, must stay fast.
